summary: The recorded base reproduces immediate-lifetime failure in the real Qwen4 loader: its self-referential nested PLE helper creates a closure cycle retaining the FQN params_dict and superseded Parameters until cyclic GC. The exact candidate replaces function-owned warning state with a per-load nonlocal boolean. Candidate regression and independent with-PLE/without-PLE adversarial cases pass, warning frequency and values are preserved, and no counterexample was found. Original L20 full-checkpoint execution was unavailable locally, but the original reporter's issue comment records successful A/B validation of this exact fix on the reported setup.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before independent probe of the actual loader. With cyclic GC disabled, replaced Parameters remained alive through the FQN-keyed params_dict both with and without PLE; baseline warning frequency and values were correct.
Candidate regression: immediate release without cyclic GC, warning once per load, matching-dtype silence, and loaded-value preservation; 3 tests, 4 subtests passed.
Independent passing-after probe: both retained-Parameter cases released immediately, no FQN dict referrer remained, warnings counted 1 then 2 across two loads, and values matched exactly.
Candidate Python syntax and patch whitespace.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2 was visible, but the issue's NVFP4 Marlin fallback requires NVIDIA SM80-SM90x. Tests exercised CPU tensor lifetime only; no local CUDA Marlin or full-model claim is made.

remaining_limitations: The original 2x NVIDIA L20 sm_89, TP2, 48-layer Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 checkpoint and weights were unavailable locally.
The assigned gfx950 device cannot execute NVIDIA Marlin, so this review did not directly remeasure the reported CUDA allocation curve or kernel numerics.
Local verification covers the real Qwen4 loader lifetime contract, not full-model serving, distributed loading, or semantic accuracy.
Original-environment A/B evidence in the upstream issue was reviewed as corroboration, not claimed as execution by this job.
